paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 114b: when Rav Dimi came, he said that Rav Chana of Carthage — and some say Rav Acha of Carthage — related: “A case came before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Bava Kamma 114b paragraph supports Rav Dimi’s report, the Chana/Acha alternative and the full title Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. The alternative name forms are preserved rather than merged into an authority identification.
